doc_structure: [{"node":"menu_content107","element":"menu_content","data":{"label":"Docs Options And Combos","key":"docs_options_and_combos_menu_content","id":"docs_options_and_combos_menu_content","name":"docs_options_and_combos_menu_content"},"elements":[{"node":"markdown101","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Options, combos and sizes","key":"md_options_combos_and_sizes","id":"options-combos-and-sizes","name":"md_options_combos_and_sizes","value":" # Options, combos and sizes Three different things are often called "modifiers". Ren POS keeps them apart, so prices, stock and kitchen tickets come out right: | What changes | How | Example | |---|---|---| | **What the product is** (its price, stock or recipe) | **Sizes**: ERPNext item variants | Fries Small / Large, Soda S / M / L | | **What it is made of** | **Components**: other items, *Included* or *Optional* | NO Tomato, Cheese ×2, Onion rings instead of fries | | **How to make it** (no stock effect) | **Instructions**: an option without an item | Medium rare, No salt, No ice | Options are set on the item: in the [item editor](/Docs/Menus%20and%20Items) of the Menu Manager (*Options & combo*), or in the Desk on the Item's **Restaurant** tab."}},{"node":"markdown102","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Sections","key":"md_sections","id":"sections","name":"md_sections","value":"# Sections Options are grouped in sections, each with its rules: - **Choose at least / At most**: *Cooking point* requires exactly 1; *Sauces* allows up to 3; 0 means optional or no limit. - **Free choices**: the first N extras are free (the cheapest ones), for example 2 free sauces. - **Ingredient modes**: each chosen option also offers **Light / Extra / On the side**. The modes are defined per restaurant in **Modifier Mode**, with how they print (*EXTRA Cheese*), what they charge and how much of the ingredient they use. - **By size** (price changes with the size): see Sizes below. - **Shared option list**: a section can use an **Option List** (Cooking point, Sauces, Choose a drink) that many items share; change it once for all of them. Options without a section go in **Ingredients**."}},{"node":"markdown103","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Each option","key":"md_each_option","id":"each-option","name":"md_each_option","value":"# Each option - **Item** (a component) or just a **text** (an instruction). - **Included** (comes with it; the waiter can remove it or ask for more) or **Optional** (can be added or chosen). - **Extra price**, and **Price if removed** for included parts that lower the price when taken out. - **Up to**: how many of it (Cheese up to ×3). - **Portion**: how much of the ingredient one unit uses (30 g), for [recipes](/Docs/Recipes). - **Checked by default** and **Unavailable** (temporarily 86 just this option)."}},{"node":"markdown104","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Combos","key":"md_combos","id":"combos","name":"md_combos","value":"# Combos A combo is an item whose sections are its parts: *Burger* (included), *Side* (choose 1: Fries, Salad, Onion rings +1.50), *Drink* (choose 1). - A part that is itself a menu item brings its own options one level down: the combo's burger still asks its cooking point and lets the guest drop the tomato. - A part with sizes asks for its size; the default (or cheapest) size is included and bigger ones charge the difference. - **Send components to their stations**: the burger goes to the grill and the drink to the bar, each with its own status. The order line stays one (one price, one invoice line). - **Price from what is chosen** (build your own): the price is the sum of the options chosen; the item's own price is not used. Bowls, salads, pizzas by toppings."}},{"node":"markdown105","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Sizes","key":"md_sizes","id":"sizes","name":"md_sizes","value":"# Sizes Give the item **Sizes** in the item editor (or make it an ERPNext template with variants). The POS shows the item once ("from $3.49"); the waiter picks the size and the line becomes that variant ("Fries Large"). - Sizes use the options of the item unless a size has its own. - **Prices change with the size**: a section marked *By size* multiplies its prices by each size's **Option price factor**. Pizza toppings at $2 on a Small (factor 1) cost $3 on a Large (1.5). - Putting the item on a menu covers all its sizes; 86 on the item blocks all of them."}},{"node":"markdown106","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"What the waiter sees","key":"md_what_the_waiter_sees","id":"what-the-waiter-sees","name":"md_what_the_waiter_sees","value":"# What the waiter sees Tapping an item with options opens a dialog with its sections, what is required (*Required · choose 1*), what is free, and the price as it changes. Included parts can be set to **Removed**, **Less**, **Normal** or **More**. The kitchen ticket prints the choices the same way the order line shows them."}}]}]
